name: regional (OSM extract splitting scripts)
what_it_holds: Shell/Python scripts (43 stars, 32 commits) to cut custom polygon extracts from a full OSM planet file and keep them updated with incremental diffs — a manual, self-hosted alternative to relying solely on Geofabrik's pre-cut regional extracts.
why_useful: Marginal: useful only if Geofabrik's existing city/region cuts don't match the exact metro polygons needed for a market (e.g. a custom Airbnb-market boundary); otherwise Geofabrik's own downloads are simpler.
time_coverage: Current + incremental diffs going forward from setup date
last_activity: Low (32 commits total, appears largely dormant)
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Marginal: useful only if Geofabrik's existing city/region cuts don't match the exact metro polygons needed for a market (e.g. a custom Airbnb-market boundary); otherwise Geofabrik's own downloads are simpler.

name: AlexMotz/us-neighborhood-geojson
what_it_holds: US neighborhood polygons in GeoJSON, converted from the same open-sourced Zillow Neighborhood Boundaries shapefiles.
why_useful: Second independent mirror of the Zillow neighbourhood boundary geometry in a directly-loadable GeoJSON format for joining STR listing coordinates to neighbourhoods.
themes: Geocoding, neighbourhood boundaries and census-tract crosswalks used for STR studies; city GIS portals with STR layers
why_all: Second independent mirror of the Zillow neighbourhood boundary geometry in a directly-loadable GeoJSON format for joining STR listing coordinates to neighbourhoods.

name: coddingtonbear/django-neighborhoods
what_it_holds: Django app + management commands importing Zillow neighborhood boundary data for most major US cities, plus a City-of-Portland-specific boundary loader; ships as importable fixtures/loaders rather than raw files only.
why_useful: A ready-made import/geocoding pipeline for turning point coordinates (Inside Airbnb listings, STR registry addresses) into neighbourhood names across many US metros at once.
themes: Geocoding, neighbourhood boundaries and census-tract crosswalks used for STR studies; city GIS portals with STR layers
why_all: A ready-made import/geocoding pipeline for turning point coordinates (Inside Airbnb listings, STR registry addresses) into neighbourhood names across many US metros at once.

name: staeco/neighborhood-boundaries
what_it_holds: Small MIT-licensed script that downloads and converts Zillow neighborhood boundary shapefiles to GeoJSON on demand.
why_useful: One-command puller for the same Zillow neighbourhood geometry other repos mirror statically; useful if the canonical Zillow source URL still resolves.
themes: Geocoding, neighbourhood boundaries and census-tract crosswalks used for STR studies; city GIS portals with STR layers
why_all: One-command puller for the same Zillow neighbourhood geometry other repos mirror statically; useful if the canonical Zillow source URL still resolves.

name: DNAinfoData/Draw-Your-Neighborhood
what_it_holds: Crowdsourced neighbourhood boundary polygons for New York City and Chicago, collected by DNAinfo's mapping project; GPL-3.0.
why_useful: Independent, resident-drawn neighbourhood polygons for two of our 13 core Inside Airbnb cities (NYC, Chicago), an alternative to official planning-department boundaries for STR listing aggregation.
themes: Geocoding, neighbourhood boundaries and census-tract crosswalks used for STR studies; city GIS portals with STR layers
